info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API allows businesses to efficiently manage their customers' shopping carts by removing unwanted items. This operation is crucial for maintaining an accurate representation of the cart's contents and enhancing the shopping experience. Typical consumers of this API include ecommerce platforms and developers integrating shopping cart functionalities. By using this endpoint, users can ensure that their customers' carts reflect current preferences and inventory. This contributes to improved customer satisfaction and potentially higher conversion rates.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This operation allows the user to remove a specific item from their shopping cart, ensuring that the cart reflects the desired items before proceeding to checkout.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details of the item to be removed from the cart. It should contain the unique identifier of the cart item that is to be deleted.

200.description: Successfully removed the item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: This schema represents the payload for the DELETE operation to remove an item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the removal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the removal operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result of the removal operation.

state.description: The current state of the cart after the removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The amount of time taken to process the removal operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the removal operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful deletion of an item from the cart.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the removal operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total processing time for the request, measured in milliseconds.
